1879073755.name: Sprint

1879088731.name: Ebbing Ire
1879088731.desc: Reduces threat generated by the Champion.

1879139035.desc: Your sharp sense of smell allows you to detect the presence of nearby Free Peoples

1879198299.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Mottled-raven)
1879198299.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879213915.name: Sudden Death (Ranged)
1879213915.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879239259.name: Steel Skin
1879239259.desc: Your experience in battle has taught you how to make best use of your armour, which affords you and your steed an increased armour rating.

1879250011.desc: Frodo is the Ringbearer, and in time of utmost need he can put on the One Ring and vanish from sight.

1879368027.name: Russet Hedgehog

1879412827.name: Night Sky Craban
